summary: 58-year-old hiker ('Bob') suffered cardiac arrest at the Manitou Incline summit after complaining of chest pains; two USAFA chemistry instructors (Maj. Thomas Heier, Capt. Benjamin Worker) plus ~20 bystanders performed prolonged CPR; EPCSAR arrived with an AED, delivered one shock, stabilized his pulse, stretchered him down to a SAR truck which met a rescue helicopter; he survived.
notes: Commendation Medals awarded 2013-03-18 to Heier and Worker; victim a triathlete with prior heart history, unacclimatized to altitude; fills El Paso zero-row year 2013 (2011/2017/2023 still zero-row).
